title: Correction of Lower Limb Deformities With Fixator Assisted Nailing
brief_summary: It is a retrospective study at a tertiary care hospital. All cases of lower limb deformity whose correction was done with fixator assisted IM nailing from 2010 till 2017 were analyzed.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

\- All those patients who underwent fixator assisted intramedullary nailing of tibia or femurs for deformity correction were included

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients who lost to follow up and those with missing records were excluded from the study.
study_population: .All those patients who has lower limb deformity irrespective of the cause underwent fixator assisted intramedullary nailing of tibia or femurs for deformity correction were included
